permission.message: Allow access to the selected site in the browser’s extension settings, then try again.

description.message: Open the official check-in page and review its points ledger alongside local activity.

remindHint.message: Shows a notification while the browser is running. Click it to open this desk.

reminderText.message: Time to check in. Click to open your desk.

confirmedHint.message: The official ledger contains a check-in credit dated today.

actionHint.message: Complete check-in and any verification on the official site, then read the ledger here.

accountHint.message: Read the ledger to see the account and timestamp.

unreadLedger.message: Read the ledger to see the site's latest points activity.

emptyLedger.message: The ledger returned no displayable entries.

missingLedger.message: The site returned a balance without an entry list.

afterOpen.message: Finish on the official site, then return to this tab.

login.message: Sign in on the official tab, then read again.

access.message: The site restricted access. Complete verification on the site, then read again.

identity.message: The site did not confirm an account. Check your current sign-in.

unavailable.message: Could not read the site. Check the connection and try again.

switched.message: The site or account changed. Read again.

multiple.message: Several check-in tabs match. Keep the one you want in this window, then try again.

noTab.message: Open the selected site's check-in page and sign in, then read again.

reload.message: Reload the official check-in tab, wait for it to load, then read again.
